structured_output.notes: All changes strictly adhere to Python standard library and vanilla web technologies with zero third-party dependencies. Verified route contracts, ephemeral port handling, SQLite schema constraints, persistence across restarts, and frontend DOM robustness.
structured_output.summary: Completed integration and quality verification of MiniBoard. Created tests/__init__.py test package marker as required by the specification. Enhanced app/server.py with resilient connection teardown, exact /api 404 routing, and socket error handling. Hardened web/app.js with safe DOM creation and robust asynchronous task indexing. Expanded tests/test_api.py with test coverage for single task retrieval, route edge cases, and CORS preflight.
